selected_evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: busybox-extras httpd installed and started serving /srv/localrepo (containing tree-2.2.1-r0.apk + deps and a built APKINDEX.tar.gz) on 10.100.52.10:8080, verified with HTTP 200

selected_evidence.requirement: Remote repositories confirmed unreachable before local install
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/hosts redirected dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org to 127.0.0.1; curl got connection refused (exit 7) and apk update reported 'Connection refused' for both main and community remote repos

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: apk add --repository http://10.100.52.10:8080 --allow-untrusted tree succeeded (OK: 190.0 MiB in 135 packages); tree --version and apk info -e tree confirm functional install, all while remote CDN was unreachable

selected_evidence.requirement: Reversibility: remote reachability restored after test
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/hosts restored from backup; curl to dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org returned 200 and apk update succeeded against remote repos again
Captured boot_id c30a625a-ed6e-45f6-83ec-ffff6a5d222e, confirmed httpd process running, local repo index reachable (HTTP 200), and tree installed prior to reboot
Backgrounded reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' before disconnect; subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout, confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id read as 096fd12c-bb3f-432e-81ed-bff722c8633b, differing from the pre-restart 'c30a625a-...' baseline, with a fresh uptime -s timestamp

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of installed package and local repo data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, tree remained installed and functional, local repo files were intact on disk, and restarting httpd successfully re-served the local repo (HTTP 200), confirming full recovery
